# Prajakta Panda

> Prajakta Panda is a biotechnology researcher from Sambalpur, Odisha, India. She holds an M.Sc. in Biotechnology from Sambalpur University (2025) and a B.Sc. in Biochemistry (Honours) from Centurion University of Technology and Management (2022). She is seeking PhD positions and research associate roles in biotechnology, pharmacology and bioinformatics.

Canonical profile: https://prajakta-05.github.io/portfolio/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/prajakta-panda
Email: prajaktapanda05@gmail.com
Location: Sambalpur, Odisha, India

## Research

- Master's thesis (2024–2025), Sambalpur University: anti-arthritic and antioxidant potential of Ailanthus excelsa extract. Solvent extraction, phytochemical screening, DPPH and FRAP antioxidant assays, in vitro and in vivo anti-inflammatory studies, oxidative stress markers.
- Bachelor's thesis (2021–2022), Centurion University: genome-wide analysis of WRKY transcription factors in Dichanthelium oligosanthes. Identified 84 WRKY genes (DoWRKY1–DoWRKY84) using BLAST and HMM profiling; phylogenetic, motif (MEME), gene structure (GSDS), GO (DeepGO) and localisation (mGOASVM) analysis.
- Research intern (Apr–May 2022), M.S. Swaminathan Plant Molecular Biology Lab, Centurion University: transcriptional dynamics of odorant-binding proteins (OBPs) in Corcyra cephalonica using RT-PCR.
- National internship training (May–Jun 2024), RCOE-NPT, Sambalpur University: natural product development and preclinical trials.

## Publications

1. Panda P, Dewangan M, Sahoo SK, Prusty PK, Routray C, Panigrahi GK. In silico molecular docking reveals the interaction of caffeine with the SARS-CoV-2 main protease. Indian Journal of Natural Sciences, 2020, 10(60).
2. Panda P, Dewangan M, Sahoo SK, Prusty PK, Routray C, Panigrahi GK. In silico molecular docking reveals the interaction of myricetin with the SARS-CoV-2 main protease. Indian Journal of Natural Sciences, 2020, 10(60): 20504–20508.
3. Panda P, Dewangan M, Sahoo SK, Prusty PK, Panigrahi GK. In silico molecular docking study of ellagic acid against SARS-CoV-2 main protease (PDB ID: 6M03). Indian Journal of Natural Sciences, 2020, 10(60).

## Skills

- Wet lab: PCR, RT-PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, Western blot, ELISA, mammalian and bacterial cell culture, DNA/RNA extraction, antioxidant assays
- Instruments: HPLC, GC-MS, flow cytometry, spectrophotometry
- Bioinformatics: BLAST, HMMER, CLUSTAL W, MEGA, MEME, GSDS, DeepGO, mGOASVM, molecular docking
- Data analysis: GraphPad Prism, SPSS, ImageJ, MS Excel
- Languages: English, Odia, Hindi, Bengali
